scope: Two vendored memory-view modules read whole and pinned. Syntax parsing only; no sys.setprofile, GC scan, GUI or target command executed.

python3_syntax.message: Missing parentheses in call to 'print'. Did you mean print(...)?

findings: MProfiler stores min/max total tracked Python object size at selected events, not allocation attributable to that function and not process RSS. Record count includes profile events rather than exclusively function calls.
MProfiler.run clears sys.setprofile in finally but does not restore a preexisting hook. Scanning all objects at selected events adds instrumentation allocation/cost to observed process.

MeliaeAdapter uses Python2 except/print syntax and cannot parse under Python3. Size contribution divides total size by parent count and caches int-rounded estimate, not independently measured exclusive memory.

best_parent sorts using self.value(node,parent), but value ignores parent and returns same cached node contribution. Selection among parents can therefore depend on input order rather than different measured ownership.
Metadata tooltips include truncated string representations; displayed object labels are not stable object/content identity.
